subject: Mobile Development
title: Android Market: Google's Answer
description: A quick win: understand Android Market: Google's Answer.

hook.text: Just months after Apple's App Store, Google launched Android Market in October 2008.

buildup.text: Android Market was more open. Google reviewed apps less strictly than Apple.

discovery.text: Developers could publish apps in hours rather than waiting days for Apple's review.

twist.text: The openness attracted both innovation and malware. Early Android had more security issues.

climax.text: Android Market rebranded to Google Play in 2012, adding books, music, and movies.

punchline.text: Google chose openness; Apple chose curation.

quiz.question: What did Android Market rebrand to in 2012?
